content: अतिवह् €1 <ab>P.</ab> To carry over or across. . --{%<ab>Caus.</ab>%} .²1 To spend, pass (as time); किं वा मयापि न दिनान्यतिवाहितानि <ls>Māl. 6. 13</ls>; अतिवाहयां बभूवत्रियामाम् <ls>R. 9. 70</ls>; ऋतून् <ls n="R.">19. 47</ls>. .²2 To let pass over, get through successfully; गुहाविसारीण्यतिवाहितानि मया कथंचिद् घनगर्जितानि <ls>R. 13. 28</ls> allowed to pass over my head, endured; स शापस्तेनातिवाहितः <ls>Ks. 33. 91</ls>. .²3 To rid oneself of, elude, avoid; अस्मिंस्तमालविटपान्धकारे प्रविश्य एनमतिवाहयावः <ls>Ratn. 2</ls>; get out of his way, elude his pursuit (and thus cheat him). .²4 To transplant, remove (to another place), bring or carry over; अलकामतिवाह्यैव वसतिं वसुसंपदाम् <ls>Ku. 6. 37</ls>. .²5 To follow, tread (as a path); लोकातिवाहिते मार्गे <ls>Sarva. S.</ls>
